encrypt_value_helper: encrypt a string value using libsodium SecretBox with URL-safe base64 encoding
decrypt_value_helper: decrypt a base64-encoded string back to its original plaintext value
encrypt_value: encrypt a string using libsodium SecretBox with SHA-256 derived signing key
decrypt_value: decrypt encrypted bytes back to a plaintext string using SHA-256 derived signing key
test_encrypt_decrypt_roundtrip: test encrypting a string and decrypting it back to verify roundtrip integrity
